# ERROR

Terminal state: the coverage workflow failed.

## Final output
- Record the failing state, command, exit code, and output location.
- Preserve partial reports as incomplete evidence.
- Identify the safe retry boundary.

## Atomic checklist
- [ ] Failure evidence is recorded.
- [ ] Partial artifacts are labeled incomplete.
- [ ] Retry or escalation path is explicit.

No further signal is required. Reset the skill after correcting the failure.
